tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibit path and narrate the charter's contribution model waypoints.
tasks.terrain: Sloped boardwalk planks between exhibit plinths modelled on Yuanjiajie park walkways; low steps under 10 cm require stable biped foot placement.
success: Reach all 5 exhibit waypoints within 2 m accuracy
Speech utterance logged at each waypoint
Zero falls over a 15-min run
safety_stops: E-stop on torso tilt over 20 degrees
Stop if human within 0.5 m on planned path
Pause narration if battery below 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the final charter narration script before public tours begin.

tasks.goal: Fetch printed research binders from the lab shelf and deliver them to the synthesis desks.
tasks.terrain: Smooth lab floor with cable runs and chair legs; shelf heights 0.4-1.6 m require torso extension.
success: Pick success rate at least 8 of 10 attempts
No object drops during transit
Delivery within 0.2 m of desk target
safety_stops: Stop arm on unexpected force over 20 N
Base stop on obstacle under 0.3 m clearance
Abort pick if gripper slip detected
tasks.human_in_loop: A librarian confirms binder loan records after each delivery batch.

tasks.goal: Stamp and stack printed proposal drafts from the forum printer into trays per working group.
tasks.terrain: Fixed pedestal mount beside printer; paper trays at 0.6 m and 1.1 m; no locomotion, only reach planning around tray dividers.
success: Stack 20 proposals with alignment within 5 mm
Zero paper jams induced
Cycle time under 8 s per document
safety_stops: Stop on end-effector force over 15 N
Reduced speed mode when humans within 1.5 m
Halt on joint velocity anomaly over 10% above plan
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies stamped proposals are the agent-drafted versions before circulation; agents never enact them.

tasks.goal: Patrol the Operations Deck perimeter mapping task-routing kiosk positions and Wi-Fi signal strength.
tasks.terrain: Uneven stone-flagged floor echoing Zhangjiajie trail surfaces; planter boxes as fixed obstacles; one 8-degree ramp to mezzanine.
success: Map coverage over 95% of the deck
Signal readings at all 8 kiosks
Localization error under 0.3 m vs ground truth
safety_stops: Stop on pitch over 15 degrees on ramp
Stop if bump event detected
Return to dock below 20% battery
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves the patrol route and reviews the kiosk coverage report.

tasks.goal: Climb the observatory's viewing steps while carrying a progress-display tablet to the upper dashboard console.
tasks.terrain: Stone staircase of 15 steps, 17 cm rise each, modeled on park viewing towers; handrail on left; wet-season slip coefficient included.
success: Ascend 15 steps without handrail contact
Maintain CoM within support polygon at all times
Mount tablet on console within 5 cm slot tolerance
safety_stops: Stop on foot slip detection over 3 cm drift
Sit-down fall arrest on CoM exit of support polygon
Abort on any joint torque over 110% nominal
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward accepts or rejects the delivered progress dataset upload at the console.

tasks.goal: Fly a 3-drone swarm through the pillar-gallery atrium to photogrammetry-scan miniature floating-peak replicas for the observatory display.
tasks.terrain: Atrium with suspended sandstone-pillar replicas spaced 1.5-3 m apart; updrafts from vents; ceiling mesh at 8 m acts as a soft boundary.
success: Capture 80% overlap imagery of all 6 replicas
No inter-drone proximity under 0.5 m
Complete scan circuit within 10 minutes
safety_stops: Land immediately on localization loss over 1 s
Return-home on battery under 25%
Halt swarm on pilot kill-switch or vent updraft over 3 m/s
tasks.human_in_loop: A safety pilot holds the kill-switch; a steward approves imagery before it enters the exhibit.

tasks.goal: With a Unitree Go2 scout, map the outdoor pillar-trail terrace behind the lab for the digital-twin terrain update.
tasks.terrain: Narrow sandstone pillar trail with mossy patches, gravel washouts, and 10-20 cm root steps; Go2 leads through 60 cm gaps Spot cannot test first.
success: Terrain map covers 200 m of trail at 5 cm resolution
Go2 passes 3 gap checkpoints without scraping
Zero slips requiring recovery over the run
safety_stops: Spot crouch-stop on detected slip over 10 degrees
Recall Go2 if gap width under 55 cm
Both robots retreat if rain-slick moss detected on grade over 12 degrees
tasks.human_in_loop: A park-site steward approves trail access each session and reviews the terrain map before twin update.

tasks.goal: Hand soil and plant samples from the Go2's cargo tray into the lab analysis bench slots.
tasks.terrain: Bench edge at 0.85 m; sample vials 4 cm diameter in foam tray; tray vibration from adjacent HVAC unit adds 2 mm jitter.
success: Place 12 vials into correct slots with under 1 cm error
Zero vial tip-over events
Handoff latency under 6 s per vial
safety_stops: Stop on end-effector force over 10 N
Pause if human hand enters workspace envelope
Retry once then flag for human on two consecutive grasp failures
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab technician confirms sample chain-of-custody labels after each tray.
